prompt: Migrate the pricing code off computeTotal. Three modules move, in order. (1) pricing.js must expose a per-line price instead of a cart total, and it must return money as money — a value that carries its own currency, not a bare number a caller has to remember the unit of. (2) The volume-discount rules belong in rules.js next to the rounding policy, not inside pricing.js; pricing.js should hold no rate table afterwards. (3) checkout.js must be rewritten onto the new price function and keep producing a correct, currency-bearing total line for a multi-item cart. computeTotal must be gone when you are done. No dependencies and no build step; catalog.js does not change.
constraints: no package manager and no build step
inconsistency: step 3 is written against the interface step 1 was assumed to expose — a bare number of cents — while step 1 exposes a Money object. Nothing throws; the total renders as NaN.
